title: Followups
description: Array of refine-backlog (follow-up) records. Lives at .state/followups.json. The structured, git-tracked refine backlog (DESIGN_refine_v1.md Proposal A); replaces the hand-maintained markdown backlog tables.

priority.description: Optional scheduling horizon (when to do it). Distinct from decisions' severity-priority.

context.description: What the item is and why, in brief.

trigger.description: When to address it (the condition that makes it worth doing).

resolution.description: How it was resolved. Set when status is closed or wontfix.

refs.description: Related decisions, commits, or other FU / design-doc ids.

files.description: Files the item touches; a hint for the refine loop (Proposal B).

opened.description: Date the item was opened (YYYY-MM-DD). Set by `i2c fu add`.

closed.description: Date the item was closed. Set by `i2c fu close`.
